svg.title: The adapted Transcriptome Transformer
svg.desc: A GROUSE-inspired editorial diagram of the PPI-initialized adapted Transcriptome Transformer. A whole-blood patient-by-gene expression matrix branches into PPI-informed shared gene embeddings and patient-specific TUPE. TUPE enters self-attention inside one shared multitask encoder, whose pooled representation feeds three binary classification heads.

text.tspan: patients × genes in one aligned matrix.
